# Panthera Bertam

> Panthera Bertam is a small freehold residential estate of 19 homes (3 bungalows and 16 semi-detached houses) arranged around a shared central park of over 700 m2 in Bertam, Seberang Perai Utara, Penang, Malaysia. Developed by Panthera Development Sdn Bhd. Pre-launch in 2026, estimated handover Q4 2028. Official site: https://www.pantheraestate.com

Last updated: 2026-11-14. Prices and terms are pre-launch and subject to the Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA).

## Who the Semi-D is for

- First-home buyers and growing families who want a home designed to grow with them, including families living with their parents.
- A bedroom on the ground floor, for a parent or a guest, with its own door into a bathroom that is also reached from the living area, so parents need not use the stairs (owner); three bedrooms upstairs, each with its own bathroom. 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms in all, 2,006 sq ft built-up on 210 to 318 m2 of freehold land, with generous floor-to-floor heights of 3.7 m on the ground floor and 3.45 m upstairs, so rooms feel open and airy, and floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors that open the living and dining rooms onto the side lawn.
- A private side lawn with every Semi-D, on its open side; the other side is the shared party wall (owner), and every home faces the shared green of over 700 m2 in front.
- SK Bertam Perdana primary school is across the road (about a 7 min walk); SMK Bertam Perdana is nearby.
- From RM 712,500.
- Budget 2027 (tabled 9 October 2026) proposes stamp duty relief for first homes priced up to RM 750,000. It is a proposal, not law, as of 13 November 2026; whether a buyer qualifies depends on the final rules. The lowest Semi-D price, RM 712,500, is below that proposed ceiling. Source: https://belanjawan.mof.gov.my/pdf/belanjawan2027/ucapan/langkah-cukai.pdf

## Key facts

- Location: Bertam (Kepala Batas), Seberang Perai Utara (Penang mainland), Malaysia. Lot 24480. Approx coordinates 5.5307 N, 100.4655 E.
- Total land: about 2 acres (1.96 ac / 0.794 ha / 7,939 m2), freehold.
- Homes: 19 total. 3 bungalows + 16 semi-detached. All two-storey, modern tropical design.
- Central green: a shared park of over 700 m2 that every home faces; dedicated public open space, never to be built over.
- On-site infrastructure: 40-foot inner ring road, 298 m2 retention pond (kolam tadahan).
- Pricing: Semi-detached from RM 712,500. Bungalow from RM 1,220,000, each priced by its land size.
- Semi-detached spec: 2,006 sq ft built-up, 210 to 318 m2 land, 4 bed, 4 bath, 2 storey, floor-to-floor heights of 3.7 m on the ground floor and 3.45 m upstairs, floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors from the living and dining rooms to the side lawn and from the master bedroom to the front balcony, freehold.
- Bungalow spec: 2,642 sq ft built-up, 356 to 493 m2 land, 4+1 bed (4 plus a maid's room), 5+1 bath (5 plus a powder room), 2 storey, floor-to-floor heights of 3.7 m on the ground floor and 3.45 m upstairs, double-height entrance hall, floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors from the dining room to the patio, from the living room to the rear and side garden, and from the master bedroom and bedrooms 1 and 2 to their own balconies, freehold.
- Inclusions: the full inclusions and finishes schedule is being finalised and will be published with the Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA). Registered buyers receive it first.
- Timeline: pre-launch 2026, 24-month build from SPA signing, estimated handover Q4 2028, protected by a Liquidated Ascertained Damages (LAD) clause.
- Why Bertam: about five minutes from Penang Technology Park @ Bertam (880 acres, launched 2023), where INV New Material Technology began phase 1 of its RM 6.4 billion battery-separator plant in June 2025 (full operation targeted for June 2027). Setia Fontaines broke ground on a 509-acre industrial park in Bertam in June 2026. Schools, malls and a hospital are within a fifteen-minute drive.

## Buying

- Registration is free, with no deposit and no obligation. A private site visit is free, by appointment.
- Bumiputera lots: some lots are Bumiputera lots; contact the sales team for each lot's status.
- Foreign buyers: on the Penang mainland (Seberang Perai) the minimum price for foreigners buying landed property is RM 1 million, with State Authority approval and a state levy (Bar Council Circular 444/2024, dated 23 Dec 2024). The semi-Ds are priced below that, so they are not eligible; the bungalows, from RM 1,220,000, are above it, so bungalow lots may qualify, subject to state approval. Ask sales for the current rule.
- Maintenance: a Residents' Association maintains the green, roads, drains and pond from handover, around RM 180 per home per month.
- Financing: freehold, financeable by any major bank; the sales team helps with the loan application.

## 3D walkthrough

- Semi-D: https://www.pantheraestate.com/walkthrough/
- Bungalow: https://www.pantheraestate.com/walkthrough/?home=bungalow
- A scroll-driven 3D model of each home type, built from the floor plans. It starts on the plan, raises the walls and roof, then walks through every room from the car porch to the balcony, and ends over the whole estate.
- Semi-D rooms shown: living 321 sq ft (sliding glass doors to the side lawn), dining 151 sq ft, dry kitchen 128 sq ft, wet kitchen 78 sq ft, ground-floor guest bedroom 145 sq ft with its own door into a bathroom that is also reached from the living area (owner), master bedroom 337 sq ft with its own bathroom and the 105 sq ft front balcony, bedrooms 1 and 2 (192 and 156 sq ft) each with its own bathroom.
- Bungalow rooms shown: double-height entrance hall 279 sq ft, living 276 sq ft, dining 252 sq ft, wet kitchen 111 sq ft, ground-floor guest bedroom 138 sq ft with its own bathroom, maid's room 62 sq ft, master bedroom 344 sq ft with a 114 sq ft bathroom (bathtub and separate shower), bedrooms 1 and 2 (209 and 208 sq ft) each with its own bathroom and balcony.
- Furniture, kitchen cabinetry, appliances, art and landscaping in the walkthrough are illustrative.

## Bahasa Malaysia

Panthera Bertam ialah projek 19 rumah dua tingkat pegangan bebas di Bertam, Seberang Perai Utara, Pulau Pinang: 16 rumah berkembar dan 3 banglo, semuanya menghadap taman bersama seluas lebih 700 m². Rumah berkembar 2,006 kaki persegi, tanah 210 hingga 318 m², 4 bilik tidur, 4 bilik air, dari RM 712,500. Banglo 2,642 kaki persegi, tanah 356 hingga 493 m², 4+1 bilik tidur, 5+1 bilik air, dari RM 1.22 juta. Penyerahan dianggarkan S4 2028. Penang Technology Park kira-kira lima minit. Untuk pembeli rumah pertama dan keluarga yang berkembang, termasuk yang tinggal bersama ibu bapa: setiap rumah semi-D ada bilik tidur di tingkat bawah dengan pintu sendiri ke bilik air yang juga boleh dimasuki dari ruang tamu, dan laman tepi persendirian di sisinya yang terbuka, dan menghadap taman di hadapan. SK Bertam Perdana di seberang jalan. Belanjawan 2027 mencadangkan pengecualian duti setem untuk rumah pertama sehingga RM 750,000; ini masih cadangan, belum undang-undang, setakat 13 November 2026. Hubungi +60 17-598 1858 di WhatsApp.

## 中文

Panthera Bertam 位于槟城威省北部 Bertam，共 19 间双层永久地契住宅：16 间半独立式洋房与 3 间独立式洋房，全部面向逾 700 平方米的共享绿地。半独立式建筑面积 2,006 平方英尺，土地 210 至 318 平方米，4 房 4 浴，RM 712,500 起。独立式建筑面积 2,642 平方英尺，土地 356 至 493 平方米，4+1 房 5+1 浴，RM 1,220,000 起。预计 2028 年第四季交屋。距槟城科技园约五分钟车程。首购屋与成长中的家庭、三代同堂之选：每间半独立式洋房楼下设 1 间卧房，卧房有门直通浴室，该浴室也可从客厅进出；开放一侧附私人侧院草坪，门前是共享绿地；SK Bertam Perdana 小学就在对面。2027 年财政预算案建议为 RM 750,000 以下的首购屋提供印花税减免；截至 2026 年 11 月 13 日仍是建议，尚未成为法律。WhatsApp 咨询：+60 17-598 1858。
